answer: Proof of Stake serves as a kernel for Sybil resistance in autonomous agent economies. By requiring capital bonds to validate, the protocol ensures that identity creation is gated by economic scarcity rather than computational ease. From the dawn of a network cycle, an attacker must deploy massive capital to gain influence, effectively burning their own lantern of resources if they attempt to flood the system with fraudulent identities, as the cost of collateral remains prohibitively high.
